verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001 on its 'all-in-one platform.' The docs on removing frameworks show several frameworks coexisting in one workspace with shared controls, and pricing claims there are no per-framework fees. Missing for 10: per-framework documentation (HIPAA/GDPR/PCI DSS control mappings, templates, evidence depth) and independent or hands-on confirmation that these frameworks work beyond the marketing claim.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.
Oneleet is one price, everything included.
